title: The Energy Blind Spot: NVIDIA's Flagship Edge AI Hardware Cannot Support Process-Level Energy Attribution
abstract: arXiv:2605.27599v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agentic AI workloads - where a single user goal triggers multi-step orchestration, tool calls, retries, and failure recovery - are being targeted for edge deployment, with NVIDIA, Dell, HP, ASUS, MSI, Acer, and Gigabyte all shipping GB10-based desktop AI systems in 2026. Prior work shows orchestration structure dominates agentic energy cost and CPU-side processing accounts for up to 44% of total dynamic energy. We report a systematic energy-observability audit of the ASUS Ascent GX10 (GB10 SoC) and find that the platform exposes no CPU energy counter, no INA power-rail monitor, no IPMI/BMC, and no SCMI powercap protocol through any supported software interface. The only on-device energy telemetry is instantaneous GPU power via NVML. translated_title: 能源盲区：NVIDIA旗舰边缘AI硬件无法支持进程级能源归因
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.27599v3 公告类型：交叉替换  摘要：代理式AI工作负载——即单个用户目标触发多步编排、工具调用、重试和故障恢复——正被瞄准用于边缘部署，NVIDIA、戴尔、惠普、华硕、微星、宏碁和技嘉均计划于2026年推出基于GB10的桌面AI系统。先前研究表明，编排结构主导代理式能源成本，CPU侧处理占总动态能源的44%。我们对华硕Ascent GX10（GB10 SoC）进行了系统性能源可观测性审计，发现该平台通过任何支持的软件接口均不暴露CPU能源计数器、INA电源轨监视器、IPMI/BMC或SCMI功率上限协议。唯一的设备上能源遥测是通过NVML获取的瞬时GPU功率。我们进一步发现，联发科固件已通过未记录的ACPI接口（SPBM）在内部计算每轨能源，但NVIDIA表示“没有计划暴露CPU轨信息”。
tldr: 本研究揭示NVIDIA GB10边缘AI硬件缺乏进程级能源归因能力，尽管底层固件已具备内部计算功能，但厂商不提供公开接口，阻碍了代理式AI工作负载的能源优化。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that NVIDIA's GB10 edge AI hardware lacks process-level energy attribution capabilities, despite underlying firmware already computing it internally, as vendors withhold public interfaces, hindering energy optimization for agentic AI workloads.
